'''Dac Madine''' was a Supply Officer within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivites of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Dac Madine grew frustrated at the delay of many of his shipments. Various Imperial [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] carrying rank insignia and [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]] materials were involved in an embarrasing series of crashes across [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] and [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

Fortunately, an Imperial trader working for [[K3|Kaythree]] located all of the six crashed shuttles, and delivered the completed crates of rank insignias and code cylinders to the delighted Dac Madine.

Dac Madine shared his surname with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]]
[[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ImperialCorporalTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Dac Madine]]
Dac Madine made a cameo appearance as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. During the Empire Day live events of [[2009]] and [[2010]], he could be found in Theed. Imperial traders doing quests for Kaythree would need to deliver crates of supplies to Dac Madine.
